notes.decision: Translated 'to set a gushing of water'. ⲭⲉ likely = ⲕⲏ/ⲕⲱ 'to set, place' (infinitive), with ⲛ-ⲟⲩ-ⲃⲉⲃⲉ ⲙⲟⲩ as object 'a gushing of water'. The line begins mid-sentence (continuation from p.79). The sense fits the cosmic-establishment context: the 4th judge sets springs and prisons in the firmament.
ⲇⲣⲟ = Lyc. reflex of ϫⲣⲟ 'prevail, conquer'; with ⲁⲣⲁϩ '(over) him' = 'they prevailed over him'. The ⲇⲣⲁⲓⲧ qualitative 'victorious' (lines 15, 24) confirms the root.
The symbol ⳨ in transcription represents ϯ 'give'; thus ⲡⲉⲧ-ϯ-ⲛⲟⲩϩⲉⲡ = 'who gives a judgment'. Same construction in line 30 (ⲉϩϯϩⲉⲡ).

Translated 'destroyed ones'. ⲧⲁⲭⲟ = causative of ⲧⲁⲕⲟ 'destroy'; qualitative ⲧⲁⲭⲁⲓⲧ 'destroyed'. Antithetical to ⲛⲉⲧⲇⲣⲁⲓⲧ 'victorious ones' — the standard pair-structure of cosmic judgment in this passage (winners ascend, destroyed are cast to the abyss, lines 17-18).

Tentatively rendered 'disturbance'. The form is unusual; possible relations: (a) ⲃⲱⲧⲥ̄ 'be removed/repelled'; (b) variant of ⲃⲱⲣⲇⲥ̄ 'tumult'; (c) ⲡⲱⲣϣ̄ 'spread out'. Context (multitude of archons of upper and lower) fits a noun of cosmic agitation/spreading. Flag for parallel research.

Wet/dry pair. ⲡⲉⲧϣⲟⲩⲱⲟⲩ clearly = 'the dry one' (ϣⲟⲟⲩⲉ 'be dry'). ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲇⲃⲉ accordingly = 'the moist/wet one' — possibly Lyc. variant of an unattested root for moisture, paired antithetically. The Virgin of Light's domain over moist and dry archons fits her standard Manichaean role with moon/water cycles.

Translated 'casting the righteous out from the sinners'. ⲛⲟⲩϩⲉ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲛ̄- = 'separate/cast forth from'. The directionality is the righteous being lifted out (saved) from the mass of sinners — fits the air-judge's discriminating function from line 31 (separating good from evil).
